name: Sparkle Smash

specialAbility.name: Unicorn Blast
specialAbility.description: Sparkle Smash fires a dazzling rainbow beam that explodes into a shower of glitter and raw power!

lore: Don't let the sparkles fool you -- Sparkle Smash hits like a meteor wrapped in a rainbow! This pink-and-purple powerhouse leaves a trail of glitter everywhere it goes, and its Unicorn Blast has sent more trucks flying than a tornado. Pretty on the outside, FIERCE on the inside!
